title: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27): New layout information fields in the aggregated metadata sheet for the Excel layout template (Object caption, Local date, and UTC timezone offset)
summary: BC27 (2025 wave 2) adds three layout information fields to the hidden Aggregated Metadata sheet of Excel layout templates: object caption, local date and UTC timezone offset. The change is listed in the AL Language extension 16.0 changelog, not in the release plan, and Word layouts do not have these fields yet.
key_points: Excel layouts contain a hidden Aggregated Metadata sheet holding ReportMetadata and ReportRequest
BC27 adds object caption, local date and UTC timezone offset fields to that sheet
The change comes from the AL Language extension 16.0 changelog and is not yet in the release plan
Word layouts gained report and request metadata access in BC26 but do not have these three new fields
